name: North Atlantic Energies
summary: North Atlantic Energies engages in refining activities in France. The company offers energy products, such as essences, diesel fuel, domestic fuel oils, and marine fuels; and specialty products, including base oils, finished lubricants, bitumen, paraffins and white oils, and additives and heavy olefins. It is also involved in the operation of a network of fuel retailers under the Esso brand; and wholesale of heating oils, diesel, non-road diesel, and fuels. The company was formerly known as Esso S.A.F. and changed its name to North Atlantic Energies in November 2025. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Nanterre, France. North Atlantic Energies operates as a subsidiary of North Atlantic France SAS.
